items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on eBay Stock?
items.summary: eBay has outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: The Weekly Closeout: Macy’s disappearing billboard and Reformation’s IPO
items.summary: The department store’s iconic sign in Herald Square was taken down. Meanwhile, the apparel retailer went public on the low end of its price range.

items.title: eBay completes $1.2bn acquisition of fashion resale platform Depop
items.summary: The platform will continue to run under its existing brand, platform and customer experience, with no immediate changes for users.

items.title: eBay (EBAY) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Debate GMV And AI
items.summary: eBay’s updated valuation work now points to a fair value of US$110.76, up from US$107.84, giving you a slightly higher price target anchor for thinking about the stock. That shift aligns with recent analyst commentary that considers stronger GMV signals, the potential impact of AI on the marketplace experience, and a wide range of views on how much upside is already reflected in current pricing. Read on to see how these factors fit together and how you can track the evolving eBay story from...

items.title: eBay Agrees To Pay Nearly $50 Million To Settle Bizarre Lawsuit After Employees Sent Massachusetts Couple Live Roaches and A Fetal Pig
items.summary: A Massachusetts couple who ran an e-commerce newsletter started receiving anonymous packages containing live cockroaches, a fetal pig, and death threats, and it took years before the full scope of who orchestrated the campaign against them came to light.

items.title: Former eBay executives allegedly sent live spiders and a bloody pig mask to critics. Now it's costing them $56 million
items.summary: A harassment campaign that left two journalists “paralyzed with fear” ended in a massive settlement. Now they’re offering lessons for anyone considering legal action against a powerful company.

items.title: Why MELI Beats A Bond At Its Own Game
items.summary: The market is treating one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies like a government bond, and the simple math behind that decision is worth a closer look.

items.title: eBay to pay nearly $50M after ex-employees allegedly terrorized couple with cockroach, fetal pig packages
items.summary: eBay agreed to pay nearly $50 million after former employees allegedly terrorized a Massachusetts couple with disturbing anonymous deliveries, cyberstalking and surveillance.
